0.original: Kageel Ja fears the dimming of the lights.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested materials to Kageel Ja.

48.original: So does Gok Golma spend yet another day bathed in golden light... Ever since the Boonewa mages worked their magicks, the crops have never looked healthier.

49.original: If I recall, it was you who procured the energy-rich vessels that helped make the lights a possibility in the first place.

50.original: Aside from the power provided by the base vessel, however, it seems the spell also requires a consumable catalyst to sustain its effect. As such, I must once again call upon your gathering expertise.

52.original: And thanks to the spell catalyst you so kindly acquired, the illumination over the gainery remains undimmed...for the moment.

53.original: Unfortunately, no source of energy lasts forever. If you're willing to lend a hand, the time has come to replenish our stocks.

54.original: The ice crystals mined around the area of Ankledeep should be sufficient for our needs. The purer, the better.

55.original: The water crystals found in the area of Ankledeep should be sufficient for our needs. The purer, the better.

56.original: The crystalfish caught in Ankledeep should be sufficient for our needs. I imagine you have some golden stonefly nymphs left over for bait.

57.original: Please head to Ankledeep and dig up the purest ice crystals you can find.

58.original: Please head to Ankledeep and gather the purest water crystals you can find.

59.original: Please head to Ankledeep with a pocketful of golden stonefly nymphs, and see if you can land us a sizable crystalfish.

60.original: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Heh...you have the look of a person who's found exactly what they were looking for.

61.original: Yes, our lights should shine all the brighter with such a dazzling source of energy.

62.original: I cannot overstate the beneficial effects of the illumination, especially given the way our vegetables have thrived beneath its glow...

63.original: We've seen steady increases in both yield and variety of crops, which means a more bountiful dinner table for everyone in Mamook! Your contributions, past, present, and future, are most appreciated.
